eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years of age or older
* Gestational age of 36 weeks or greater
* American Society of Anesthesiology physical status 2
* Induction of labor or early labor (cervical dilation \< 6cm)
* Singleton gestation
* Vertex presentation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Preeclampsia
* Receiving magnesium sulfate
* Having received narcotics within 4 hours
* Multiple gestation
* Major fetal anomalies or demise
* Previous spine surgery
* Known major spine pathology
* Substance use disorder
